body.name: \(\mathcal H_P\)
body.def: For a regular path \(P_t\) with tangent \(\delta\), let \(\dot a_p=\partial_t a_{p_t}|_{t=0}\) and \(\dot a_T=\partial_t a_{T_t}|_{t=0}\) be the translations selected by \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}\), and set \(\mathcal H_P[\delta]=(\dot a_T-\nabla\mathcal L_B^{-1}\Pi_0[(\mathsf C\nabla\alpha)\cdot\dot a_p])_{\mathcal Y_J}\).
